name: Epidemiology
notes: Six courses; fulfills the social sciences academic division of the Rochester Curriculum.
Students may major, OR minor, OR complete a cluster within the public health-related programs - not more than one.
NO MORE THAN ONE COURSE may overlap between a public health minor and another program of study.
STAT 212 was the older code for the introductory statistics requirement; STAT 180 is current.

requirementGroups.label: Public health core
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Required Courses. PHLT 101: Introduction to Public Health I; PHLT 103: Concepts of Epidemiology

requirementGroups.label: Introductory statistics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus one of the following: STAT 180: Intro to Applied Statistical Methodology; STAT 212: Applied Statistics I

requirementGroups.label: Three epidemiology courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus three of the following: PM 414U: History of Epidemiology; PM 415U: Principles of Epidemiology; PM 413U: Field Epidemiology; PM 424U: Chronic Diseases Epidemiology; PM 451U: Infectious Disease Epidemiology; PM 470U: Environmental and Occupational Epidemiology; PM 489U: Injury Epidemiology and Emergency Care Research Methods
requirementGroups.note: PM COURSE NUMBERING: the department writes these with a 'U' suffix, but the catalog and the other public-health programs in this planner carry most of them without it. The catalog form is used so a placed course is recognized across programs.
